Water Breathing (W3 Tran): Allows touched creatures to breathe underwater for a total of 8 hrs
Water Walk (C3 Tran): Allows 4 touched creatures to walk on liquid as if it were a solid surface for 40 min
Waves Of Exhaustion (W7 Necr): 60' cone inflicts exhausted
Waves Of Fatigue (W5 Necr): 30' cone inflicts fatigued
Web (W2 Conj): R140' Anchored web strands in a 20' radius immobilize creatures (save Reflex negates, and a DC 20 Strength or DC 25 Escape Artist breaks free) for 40 min; movement through the web requires a Strength or Escape Artist check each rd, allowing 5' of movement for each 5 points that the check exceeds 10; burning clears the web, inflicting 2d4 HP fire on those within
Weird (W9 Illu): R140' Fears of targets in a 15' radius create creatures (save Will negates) whose touch kills its target (save Fortitude inflicts 3d6 HP, -1d4 Str, and stunned for 1 rd)
Whirlwind (D8 Evoc): R560' 10' radius, 30' high cyclone moves 60' as directed each rd, inflicting 3d6 HP on Large and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates), for 4 rd; it traps Medium and smaller creatures (save Reflex negates), inflicting an additional 1d8 HP on each subsequent rd
Whispering Wind (B2 Tran): R4 miles Allows sending a whispered 25-word message or sound to a familiar 10' area
Whispering Wind (W2 Tran): R4 miles Allows sending a whispered 25-word message or sound to a familiar 10' area
Wind Walk (C6 Tran): Allows self and 1 touched to spend 5 rd changing to and from a translucent vapor that can move 60 MPH, for 4 hr
Wind Walk (D7 Tran): Allows self and 1 touched to spend 5 rd changing to and from a translucent vapor that can move 60 MPH, for 4 hr
Wind Wall (C3 Evoc): R140' Creates a 40'x20'x2' curtain of air that scatters objects, bars gasses and Small or smaller flying creatures, and deflects arrows and bolts for 4 rd
Wind Wall (D3 Evoc): R140' Creates a 40'x20'x2' curtain of air that scatters objects, bars gasses and Small or smaller flying creatures, and deflects arrows and bolts for 4 rd
Wind Wall (W3 Evoc): R140' Creates a 40'x20'x2' curtain of air that scatters objects, bars gasses and Small or smaller flying creatures, and deflects arrows and bolts for 4 rd
Wish (W9 Univ): Alters reality, with few limits; costs at least 5,000 XP to cast
Wood Shape (D2 Tran): Reshapes a 14 cubic feet piece of wood (save Will negates)
Word Of Chaos (C7 Evoc): Nonchaotic creatures within 40' with 4/3/-1/-6 HD are banished to their home planes for 24 hr (save Will -4 negates) and become deafened for 1d4 rd/stunned for 1 rd/confused for 1d10 min/killed
Word Of Recall (C6 Conj): Self and 1 willing touched return to a chosen sanctuary
Word Of Recall (D8 Conj): Self and 1 willing touched return to a chosen sanctuary
Zone Of Silence (B4 Illu): Prevents sound from escaping a 5' radius for 4 hr
Zone Of Truth (C2 Ench): R35' Prevents creatures in a 20' radius from lying (save Will negates) for 4 min
Magic Notes:
Intelligence Wizard Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level W1, W2
School Specialization (Conjuration): +1 Conjuration spell slot in each spell level
Simple Somatics: Suffers no arcane spell failure risk from wearing light armor
Wisdom Cleric Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level C1
Wisdom Druid Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level D1
Wisdom Paladin Spell Slot Bonus: Spell level P1
Detect Evil: Can use Detect Evil effects at will
Empower Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 2 levels higher than normal to increase its variable effects by 50%
Empowered Divination: +1 caster level on Divination spells
School Opposition (Enchantment): Cannot learn or cast Enchantment spells
School Opposition (Necromancy): Cannot learn or cast Necromancy spells
Scribe Scroll: Can create scrolls for known spells
Spontaneous Casting (Cleric): Can cast Cure or Inflict spells in place of prepared spells
Spontaneous Casting (Druid): Can cast Summon Nature's Ally spells in place of prepared spells
Widen Spell: Can cast a spell using a spell slot 3 higher than normal to double its area of affect

Companion Notes:
Companion Improved Evasion: Has increased Companion Evasion effects
Animal Companion: Can have a special bond with an animal that has expanded abilities
Bonus Tricks: Companion can learn 2 additional tricks, requiring no training time or Handle Animal checks
Companion Evasion: Successful Reflex saves by companion yield no damage instead of half, and failed Reflex saves yield half damage
Deliver Touch Spells: Can use companion to deliver touch spells if in contact when the spell is cast
Empathic Link: Can communicate emotions with companion up to 1 mile
Share Spells: Can cast a personal spell on an adjacent companion and have a targeted spell cast on self also affect a companion while it is within 5'
Summon Familiar: Can bond with a magical creature with expanded abilities; death of the creature inflicts a loss of NaN experience points (save Fortitude DC 15 half), and a new familiar cannot be summoned for a year and a day
